PF-004 at f98a31502f6863e0c29dc97c0f3b233c919d1b32: every mutable aggregate declares revision_model, transaction_boundary and outbox, with the four combinations outbox_events.unique(aggregate_id, aggregate_revision) forbids rejected by validate_state_vocabularies.py.

findings.title: OAuth, linked identity, recovery, and ranked identity
Device lineage, challenge, replay, checkpoint, and recovery
closure_evidence: PF-009 at 48b22762fcce6d84650f352867f717ae9df41920: device_sequences keys on lineage_id and no longer references a device row, continuity_state has one owner in device_lineages, and claim_challenges carries a lineage_id foreign key. A copied device store previously produced two internally continuous rows, making the fork invisible to the counter meant to catch it.

findings.title: Local daemon, shell, IPC, and platform supervision
closure_evidence: PF-011 at 355755b365f3b1ee0ac158255af21a103303ea1d: all eight local roles are declared once in packages/schemas/local-trust-domains-v1.json with an OS peer identity per platform, a session boundary, an explicit network scope and capability, data-class and prohibition lists. PLATFORM_KEY_AND_PRIVILEGE_MATRIX.md tabulated six and omitted the interactive shell and the privileged supervisor — the only role taking arbitrary operator input and the only one running elevated. The separation the privacy boundary rests on is enforced: exactly one role may read transcript-content and its network scope is none. The local channel protocol, shell/subsystem separation and local persistence remain open under PF-012, PF-013 and PF-014.

PF-012 at da930f9c961ef9d029b68e9bb1aee3561551af2c: local-control-v1.proto reaches every message body only through its own role's arm, so a collector encoding a deletion request is unrepresentable rather than rejected. Envelope previously carried one universal oneof holding all fifteen bodies with sender_role a field the sender filled in, while LOCAL_IPC_AND_DEVICE_IDENTITY.md stated that role confusion is rejected. Three local-channel reason codes now exist for what remains detectable; the protocol previously had no vocabulary with which to refuse anything. Shell/subsystem separation and local persistence remain open under PF-013 and PF-014.

PF-013 at da930f9c961ef9d029b68e9bb1aee3561551af2c: interactive-shell declares only the eight process and connection states. It previously carried fifteen, collapsing collection, sync, auth, permission, update and connectivity into one state variable, so a device with paused collection and an offline network had no representable shell state. Five projections now persist in local-store-v1.sql. Local persistence and migration remain open under PF-014.

PF-014 at da930f9c961ef9d029b68e9bb1aee3561551af2c: the canary fixture now covers log, backup, diagnostic and corruption-report, the four surfaces that carry content by accident rather than by design and the four the acceptance named. Repairing it found four pre-existing negative cases naming a forbidden class in snake_case where the allowlist declares kebab-case, so they resolved to nothing; a fifth naming otel-identity-attributes, which was declared nowhere; and two cases sharing one canary token, which defeats attribution. All four units serving SR-008 have landed.

findings.title: Universal adapter certification and deterministic accounting
closure_evidence: PF-015 at da930f9c961ef9d029b68e9bb1aee3561551af2c: the compatibility tuple's canonical digest is proved rather than asserted. The schema stated that the digest is over the RFC 8949 core deterministic CBOR encoding so two implementations cannot disagree about a tuple's identity, and nothing tested it; the unit's own note recorded the digest half as not landed. Two serialisations in opposite key order at every level now produce one digest, and each of the five independent dimensions changes it. Certification lifecycle and accounting reconciliation remain open under PF-016 and PF-018.

findings.title: Idempotency and ambiguous commit recovery
closure_evidence: PF-019 at bf1a128ace7a3d6e8cccc2585270382da242aaee: idempotency_records keys on exactly the key_scope openapi-v1.yaml#x-idempotency-contract declares, so operation_id is inside the key and one key across two operations can no longer be answered with the other operation's recorded response. replayable-failure and abandoned replace a single failed state, which is the distinction a retry needs.

findings.title: Export, deletion, retention, and backup tombstones
Release authorization, compatibility, migration, and rollback
Current-authorization recheck at every display and delivery boundary
closure_evidence: PF-021 at 7891df41e9fb4b27c7fae378beea67a9aed7e971: getPublicProfile required no viewer while projection-authorization-v1.json made directional-block deny-hard, so a blocked person could read the profile by logging out. It now requires a session and returns 401 without one. The recheck at every other display and delivery boundary is not done.

restatement.previous_form: Privacy-safe projection and current authorization, stated as a repairable cluster with no artifact set of its own.
restatement.rationale: Independent review found no independent artifact set: the aggregates named in the original wording are already owned by SR-010, SR-011 and SR-013, so the finding could not be closed by repairing anything it exclusively owned. It is restated as the invariant it actually asserts - every display and delivery boundary rechecks current authorization instead of replaying a historical snapshot - and bound to the boundary operations where that recheck is absent today. The artifact set intentionally intersects SR-010, SR-011 and SR-013 at different sites: those findings own their aggregates, this one owns the boundary. Closure is one enumerated boundary matrix plus a current-authorization check at every listed boundary, and is not satisfied by repairing any single aggregate.

findings.title: Review-record integrity: reviewed head, evidence class, and named owners

restatement.previous_form: Review, conformance, and launch-evidence integrity, owned by the document that states the finding.
restatement.rationale: The finding was self-owned: its normative owners were the semantic-review document that states it and the schema inventory, so its closure evidence would have been the same prose that defines it and no external record could contradict it. Ownership moves to the two machine records that own reviewed-head and evidence-class facts, and the prose review documents become conflicting artifacts. The disagreement is now machine-checkable: REPAIR_HEAD_REVIEW.md pins e1320a6, the semantic review states base 41ecb77, and review-target-v1.json is not-pinned with a null commit; separately the state-machine registry names persistence owners for 19 of its 26 machines that packages/schemas/planning-schema.sql does not define. Closure is a pinned review-target-v1.json whose commit exists and whose verdict is recorded, prose head claims equal to it, suite names that match what each suite executes, and one resolved persistence owner for every registered machine.

findings.title: Source-bound evidence and verifier appraisal authority

restatement.previous_form: Stated as a contradiction whose closure required four unwritten schemas, with an artifact set that named nothing existing.
restatement.rationale: Independent review found that authoring an absent schema is a design task rather than a disagreement between two authorities, so the finding as written could not be falsified. It is split into the two things it actually contains. The contradiction part is live and now cited: one appraisal aggregate is described three ways - vibeproof-claim-v1.cddl verifier-appraisal-v1 carries seven classification dimensions, evidence-profile-policy-v1.json enumerates the same seven dimensions as server-verifier authority, and planning-schema.sql verifier_appraisals persists only provenance, continuity and integrity state with no claim digest, evidence digest, validity interval or supersession. The design part is the four artifacts already recorded planned-missing in SCHEMA_AND_INTERFACE_INVENTORY.md; they move to planned_artifacts, because a path that does not exist cannot be cited as a conflicting artifact. Closure requires both halves: the three existing authorities agree on one appraisal record, and the four planned artifacts exist and bind the exact claim, evidence, policy and result under D-077.
